title: Use Fetch to load local activity list
goal: concatenates fetch, Response.ok, Response.json() and interface rendering.
summary: has three Data URL data built into the drop-down box. fetch directly reads local samples, and you can practice the same parsing process in offline classes.
tasks: clears #events when #load is clicked, and then fetches the value of the current #dataset. Check response.ok, then await response.json().
renders the li with the returned activities array. Successfully displays "Activities updated", empty array displays "No activities", and failure in reading or parsing displays "data cannot be read".

example.note: fetch returns Response successfully. json() still needs to wait independently, and parsing errors can be handed over to the same catch.

hint: Use try...catch to wrap requests, status checks and JSON parsing; clear the old list before each load.
